Pre-seed startup (Seedling) with a current monthly budget of $3,000 and plans to raise in the fall and scale spend in ~6 months; pursue a nurture sequence and re-engage post-funding for expanded SEO/marketing work.

Contact (student email) says their family's 4-location restaurant group needs local SEO but lists a $2,500/month budget and provides no company or website—fits our services but is below the $15k+ threshold and needs follow-up info, so send to nurture (same contact as L-002).
Local HVAC company seeking more service calls (fits Single Grain services) but stated monthly budget $6,000 is below the $15k+ threshold, so route to nurture.

Healthcare staffing platform NorthPeak Health (team of 3 marketers) requests compliant-sensitive demand gen and states a $15,000/month budget—sales should call to move forward (budget parsed from text).
Company provided a qualified budget of $22,000/month but submitted an empty message with no stated marketing need—promising lead to nurture and qualify before sales outreach.
Data-deletion (GDPR/CCPA) request, not a sales lead; route to the privacy owner, who has a legal deadline.
Phishing pattern (payment pressure plus a link to an executable); do not open the link, report to security.
